pregunta: ¿Qué porcentaje de las órdenes entregadas llegó después de la fecha estimada?
motivo_juez: El agente responde con el porcentaje correcto (8,11 %) y explica el cálculo, cumpliendo la pregunta.
respuesta:
- De las órdenes que efectivamente fueron entregadas (96 476), 8,11 % (7 827) llegaron después de la fecha estimada de entrega.  
- Cálculo: `COUNT(late) / COUNT(total) * 100`, donde “late” son las filas con `order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date`.  
- **Advertencia:** Solo se consideran órdenes con fecha de entrega al cliente registrada; las órdenes sin entrega no están incluidas en este porcentaje.
consultas:
["WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_late,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) AS late_cnt,
    COUNT(*) AS total_delivered
FROM delivered;"]

respuesta:

*Solo se consideraron categorías con ≥ 30 reseñas; los promedios se calcularon sobre reseñas distintas por orden.*
consultas:
["WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.review_score, p.product_category_name
  FROM order_reviews r
  JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
), cat_counts AS (
  SELECT pc.product_category_name, pc.product_category_name_english,
         AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score,
         COUNT(*) AS n_reviews
  FROM reviews r
  JOIN product_category_name_translation pc ON r.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name
  GROUP BY pc.product_category_name, pc.product_category_name_english
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT product_category_name_english AS categoria_ingles, avg_score, n_reviews
FROM cat_counts
ORDER BY avg_score ASC
LIMIT 5;"]

["WITH reviews_state AS (
    SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
           r.review_score
    FROM order_reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id

)

       AVG(review_score) AS avg_score,
       COUNT(*) AS n_reviews

LIMIT 1;"]
